term: whole, intelligent maker, embodiment and God-like agent in #86
definition: Whole and made-by designate the source’s unelaborated whole/maker relation. Cannot be made by embodied agents is a capability exclusion, distinct from actual nonproduction. Some selected intelligent unembodied agent is required to be God-like by a particular whole; God-like has no specified classical or positivity signature.
note: No Sum2 fusion, common maker, causal-grounding identity, unique/necessary God or concrete rigid witness is introduced. Effect-level exclusion, agent embodiment, selected-whole identity and requirement-to-possession applicability remain interpretive obligations.
